text:
Winnipeg arrives at Florida on the second night of a back-to-back, a night after a 6-4 loss in Tampa left the Jets winless in seven (0-5-2). Josh Morrissey and Vladislav Namestnikov are out, and Neal Pionk is up to 25:05 a night with Mario Ferraro moving in beside DeMelo. Florida beat Winnipeg 5-1 three days ago and is 3-2-0 in its last five, but it is missing Brad Marchand and Aleksander Barkov. Carter Verhaeghe has taken Marchand's spot beside Reinhart and Tkachuk.

Our numbers favor the Panthers, projecting 3.45 expected goals (a measure of chance quality) to the Jets' 2.79. At five on five, Florida has taken 53% of the expected goals to Winnipeg's 47%. Florida's power play creates 1.13 expected goals a game, but the Panthers also take 5.6 penalties a game. In net, projected starters Nico Daws (-1.32 goals saved above expected this season) and Akira Schmid (-0.2) are both struggling, and Schmid is at -1.1 over last season's 34 games.

For Florida, Sam Reinhart is 40% to score and Matthew Tkachuk 75% for a point. Kyle Connor leads Winnipeg at 42% to score. Among our under-the-radar picks, Brady Tkachuk plays about 16:18 a night on the third line but has 4.8 expected goals in his last 10 games, and we have him at 34% to score. Cole Perfetti is 53% for a point, above his season pace, with his line creating chances. Both are players to watch, not locks.
